metadata.title_complement: QUALITATIVE AND QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS WITH THE BLOWPIPE

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The text features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes and the vertical stress characteristic of the Modern/Didone style prevalent in 19th-century printing. The serifs are thin and horizontal, typical of the transition from Old Style to the more mechanical precision of the industrial era.
